events.label: SPCX added to Nasdaq-100 (~$4.3B QQQ/QQQM forced buy at close); Dual-gate Day 2 attempt
events.note: SPCX heads into inclusion at $156.45 (July 6 close) — 12.7% below the $185 re-entry gate after Day 9 distribution prevailed. $4.3B QQQ/QQQM forced passive buy executes at the July 7 close regardless of macro. Sell any inclusion-day spike above $175; DO NOT enter on the spike. NVDA full-size add gate: check at 9:25 AM ET (NVDA >$200 + SPX >7,460 + VIX <17 simultaneously). Dual-gate Day 2: SPX must again close above 7,460 AND VIX below 17 for HIGH conviction upgrade. BTC UTC midnight close from July 6 (8 PM ET) is the overnight gate check that precedes this session.

events.label: FOMC June 17 minutes (~2 PM ET) — written pre-57K NFP; potentially hawkish relative to current pricing
events.note: Minutes from the June 17 FOMC meeting. Written before 57K NFP (July 2) and before ISM Services 54.0% (July 6). Nine of 18 officials projected at least one 2026 hike at June 17. Current July 28 hike probability is ~19% — if the minutes read hawkish (inflation focus, 3-hike path maintained), probability could bounce back toward 25-30%, compressing Nasdaq multiple at P/E ~28x and putting the 30Y through 5.00% temporarily. Dovish tone (data dependence, growth concerns flagged) = September cut confirmed. Plan for 2 PM ET volatility. SK Hynix ADR listing context building toward July 10.

events.label: PepsiCo (PEP) Q2 2026 earnings — Q2 earnings season kickoff; consumer demand barometer
events.note: PepsiCo is the first significant Q2 2026 earnings report. A beat with raised guidance = consumer demand held up despite 57K NFP growth scare, supporting the soft-landing narrative and BUY regime. A miss or lowered guidance = growth-scare confirms, risk-off pressure before CPI July 14. Sets the tone for the consumer-staples read heading into Q2 earnings season peak (META, GOOGL, MSFT, AMZN all reporting late July).

events.label: SK Hynix (SKHY) Nasdaq ADR listing — $29.4B offering; Delta Air Lines (DAL) Q2 earnings
events.note: Two sector clearing events: (1) SK Hynix SKHY Nasdaq ADR listing ($29.4B, 17.79M shares; underwriters BofA, Goldman, Citi, JPMorgan). ADR pricing above offering = institutional vote of confidence in HBM4 demand thesis; constructive for NVDA, TSM, AVGO. Below = Korea circuit breaker HBM4 concern confirmed. SK Hynix mandatory KRX exit executed at July 7 KST open per Stop Day 2 protocol. (2) Delta Air Lines Q2 earnings tests whether 57K NFP growth scare is filtering into travel demand — strong bookings support consumer resilience thesis.

events.label: June CPI release (est. 8:30 AM ET) — regime-defining; May baseline 4.2%; ISM Prices Paid fell 9.1pt in June
events.note: June CPI is the summer's regime-defining event. Context: ISM Services Prices Paid dropped to 73.0 from 82.1 in May; WTI averaged $66-70 in June (first full month of Iranian oil normalization); May CPI was 4.2% YoY. Scenario A: CPI ≤3.5% → rate-cut cycle confirmed; BUY upgrades to HIGH conviction regardless; full earnings season adds activated. Scenario B: CPI ≥4.0% → stagflation risk; STEP ASIDE or BEARISH warranted even with weak NFP. Scenario C: 3.5-4.0% → maintain MEDIUM conviction BUY. The Strategy BTC Monetization Program ($216M/$60,200 avg) adds a crypto-specific overhang if CPI surprises hawkish (rate hold = BTC headwinds).

events.label: TSLA Q2 2026 earnings (est.) — after market close; 480K delivery beat sets the floor
events.note: Q2 earnings follow the July 2 delivery report: 480,126 vehicles delivered (vs. 406,024 consensus; +25% YoY; best-ever Q2). Despite the blowout beat, TSLA fell ~7.49% on July 2 (sell-the-news + growth scare). Q2 earnings call (~July 22) is the fundamental clearing event: need gross margin recovery (>25%), FSD revenue recognition at scale, and Q3 delivery guide >450K for the stock to re-rate above $420. Weak gross margin (<22%) or no FSD clarity = $393 July 2 close is the near-term top.

events.label: FOMC meeting (July 28-29) — hike probability ~19% after 57K NFP; June CPI (~Jul 14) is the determining input
events.note: July 28 FOMC hike probability ~19% after 57K NFP collapse. June CPI July 14 is the primary input. CPI ≤3.5% = hike probability collapses further; CPI 4.0%+ = September hike back on the table. SCOTUS upheld Fed independence June 29 — Warsh can move in either direction without political pressure. Strategy BTC Monetization Program adds crypto-specific rate sensitivity: higher-for-longer = BTC downside; cuts confirmed = BTC positive.

events.label: META Q2 2026 earnings — AI cloud business first quantification; earnings season peak week
events.note: META Q2 earnings July 29 is the first event where management must quantify the cloud business (Bloomberg July 1: Meta building AI cloud to sell excess compute). META +2.98% on July 6 on rate-relief bid. Q2 earnings is the first AI-at-scale quarter. GOOGL, MSFT, and AMZN also report in mid-to-late July — peak Q2 earnings risk window. ISM Services 54.0% (July 6) validates the Search and Cloud AI expansion narrative.

events.label: Iran-US Islamabad Declaration 60-day deadline — Hormuz full reopening + sanctions relief
events.note: Deal operational from June 18 MOU signing; 60-day window expires August 13. WTI averaged $66-70 in June (Brent $71.30-$72.49 on July 6). If August 13 deadline met with full Hormuz clearance and sanctions relief, WTI could extend to $62-65. Failure or reversal = oil spike reversal; Brent $97 trigger returns to focus. Current Brent ~$71.90 = $25.10 buffer.

events.label: NVDA Q2 FY27 earnings (est.) — $91B revenue guide; AI capex cycle fundamental clearing event
events.note: NVDA's Q2 FY27 earnings is the fundamental clearing event for the AI capex thesis. $91B revenue guidance represents sequential acceleration. NVDA Stop Day 2 survived July 6 by $0.84 margin — half-size hold maintained. Full-size add gate opens at July 7 open if NVDA >$200 + SPX >7,460 + VIX <17 simultaneously. August 26 earnings remains the ultimate fundamental clearing event for the AI-infrastructure re-rating. TSM, AMD, AVGO all read-through from NVDA.

events.label: SPCX first earnings as a public company (approx.) — Starlink ARR + Starship cadence
events.note: First earnings print since June 12 IPO. SPCX Nasdaq-100 effective July 7. Re-entry gate: two consecutive closes above $185 on above-average volume (est. July 9-11 earliest, given $156.45 July 6 close). First earnings (Starlink subscriber/ARR growth, Starship launch cadence, cash burn) is the fundamental clearing event after the inclusion-day distribution pattern.

events.label: SPCX 180-day IPO lock-up expiry (approx.) — insider/early-investor float unlock
events.note: ~180 days after the June 12 debut, early investors and insiders can sell, materially expanding the ~4% public float. Lock-up expiries are a known supply overhang for hot IPOs. The $20B bond offering (June 22) already changed the capital structure risk profile — the lock-up expiry adds equity supply overhang.

events.label: OpenAI IPO — target window shifts to H1 2027 after 2026 delay
events.note: OpenAI delayed its anticipated 2026 IPO to H1 2027 (announced June 26, 2026). SoftBank sold off -13% on the delay. Microsoft and NVIDIA hold strategic stakes. The delay removes a near-term AI sentiment catalyst and adds uncertainty to AI infrastructure spending trajectories.
